title: Wan 3.0 gets its own prompting guide and recipe (it borrowed Wan 2.2's)
description: Fabio 2026-10-04: Cosmo read guide:wan-2.2 to write a Wan 3.0 prompt. Wan 3.0 has its own grammar (Alibaba's official guide: overall description, Image N / Video N / Audio N citations, timed shots, dialogue and sound lines, a trailing negative list), so it needs its own enhancer recipe (wan-3.0) and agent guide (docs/agent/models/wan-3.0.md), built per /create-enhancer-recipe from the official guide, the wan3-pe skill and the OpenArt guide. Other borrowed guides (Veo -> kling-3.0, Seedream and Nano Banana -> flux-2) stay a known issue for after 2.0.
